tutorials.title: Thin your paints and control the brush
tutorials.creator: Reaper Miniatures
tutorials.summary: Understand paint dilution and how to unload a brush before it floods the miniature.
tutorials.practice: Try a few controlled strokes on a palette before painting a model.

tutorials.title: Drybrushing
tutorials.creator: Warhammer Colour
tutorials.summary: Explore a quick highlighting technique for raised texture and detail.
tutorials.practice: Start on a spare textured base or a small patch of fur.

tutorials.title: Shading
tutorials.creator: Warhammer Colour
tutorials.summary: Build depth by introducing darker tones into a miniature’s details.
tutorials.practice: Practice on one small area before shading a whole model.

tutorials.title: Basing
tutorials.creator: Warhammer Colour
tutorials.summary: Finish the ground beneath a miniature so the base supports the model.
tutorials.practice: Test your ground colours on a spare base first.

tutorials.title: Layered highlights
tutorials.creator: The Army Painter
tutorials.summary: Use successive highlights to define raised surfaces and smaller details.
tutorials.practice: Pick one armour panel and compare it with an unhighlighted panel.

tutorials.title: Edge highlighting
tutorials.creator: The Army Painter
tutorials.summary: Use brush placement and a chosen light direction to sharpen hard edges.
tutorials.practice: Use a spare weapon or armour plate to practice short, steady lines.

tutorials.title: Glazing and paint consistency
tutorials.creator: The Army Painter
tutorials.summary: Compare layering, glazing, and wet blending to choose the right paint consistency.
tutorials.practice: Make a small test strip to compare coverage with transparent colour.

tutorials.title: Wet blending and smooth transitions
tutorials.creator: Massive Voodoo
tutorials.summary: Study paint consistency, working time, and the refinement of colour transitions.
tutorials.practice: Use a broad spare surface so you can focus on blending rather than tiny details.

tutorials.title: Object-source lighting
tutorials.creator: David · Light Miniatures
tutorials.summary: Plan believable glow effects using brightness, colour, direction, and distance.
tutorials.practice: Choose a single imagined light source before trying multiple glows.

tutorials.title: Non-metallic copper
tutorials.creator: Richard Gray Creations
tutorials.summary: Explore reflective copper painted with ordinary colours and deliberate light–dark contrast.
tutorials.practice: Practice reflection placement on a spare curved surface before a centrepiece.
